name: Alchemize
long_description:
Alchemize is a code review platform that helps teams understand PRs and ship faster.

Agentic coding has 10x’d code output. Teams are opening larger PRs more frequently, but the current tools don’t support this new coding paradigm. 

Alchemize automatically breaks down PRs into guided, understandable reviews. It breaks each PR into manageable, smaller PRs that reveals the original author’s (human or agent) intent. We show where changes begin, how data flows, and which decisions require human judgment.
one_liner: Code Review Platform that Simplifies PRs to Ship Faster
